W.note: Polished collapsed row with progress bar and smooth grid-height transition, but the opened card is tall, it has a needless package dropdown, no explicit next-step guidance, and status changes are not announced.

X.note: Tiny pill that expands to a dense timeline with next-step note, copy and carrier link, plus dismiss, restore tab, live region and Escape, though the collapsed ETA truncates and the expanded meta row wraps awkwardly.

Y.note: Smallest footprint, clean expanded layer with tracking number, next-step line, timestamped timeline and labelled actions, live region and Escape support, with only minor truncation and a wrapping button label.

Z.note: Attractive teal accent, progress bar and timeline, but it omits the carrier and tracking number and a clear next step, leaves dead space at the bottom, and has weak screen-reader announcements.
